title: Warm Smoky Mexican Almond Tacos
description: A malty, aerated, nostalgic Mexican dish featuring almond paste, with a smoky and cold twist, low in calories and friendly to diets, this is a unique taco experience.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a bowl, mix together almond paste, smoked paprika, malted milk powder, and a pinch of salt.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spreading a tablespoon of the almond paste mixture onto each tortilla.
Top the almond paste with diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Drizzle the cold-pressed lime juice over the top of each taco.
Serve the tacos with a dollop of low-fat sour cream on the side.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of smoked paprika, if desired.
